recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split composition featuring a highly decorative, vintage book-spine-inspired panel on the left and a desaturated, moody portrait of a man on the right. The design blends tactile textures like linen and aged paper with elegant, hand-drawn filigree and whimsical custom lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: The ornate left panel acts as a heavy anchor for the airy, blurred background of the portrait.
The vertical line of the book spine creates a sharp division between graphic ornament and photographic realism.
The desaturated skin tones of the subject harmonize with the muted gold and burgundy of the decorative panel.
The subject's downward gaze directs the viewer's eye back toward the central text block.
coreInvariants: Intricate symmetrical filigree patterns above and below the text.
Muted, desaturated color palette with high contrast in the subject's clothing.
Textured linen or canvas overlay across the entire image.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, captured from the waist up, slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The decorative left panel with its high-contrast gold-on-dark-red pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his downward gaze to the text, then moves vertically along the filigree patterns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the portrait features a soft, blown-out background providing breathing room for the dense graphic panel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep burgundy and charcoal black provide the structural base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted gold/cream for the filigree and text against the dark panel.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale, desaturated skin tones and a light checkered tie provide focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; value contrast is high between the dark suit and the bright, hazy background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure white; use cream or off-white

letterConstructionRules: Elongated ascenders and descenders that integrate with filigree
Varying stroke weights with a hand-drawn, slightly shaky quality
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is often smaller and elevated
Terminals end in small, rounded dots or curls
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the large, whimsical display text with a smaller, more legible but still hand-drawn serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Vertical border lines with dot-and-dash patterns

preserve: The hand-drawn quality of the ornaments

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, flowing lines and whimsical proportions.
Matches the historical, decorative context of the book spine.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a dark Victorian-style suit and checkered tie, looking down, against a hazy, desaturated background. On the left, include a wide vertical band of deep burgundy with a heavy linen texture and a thin decorative gold border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom, hand-drawn cream-colored lettering in the center of the burgundy band. Surround the text with symmetrical gold filigree and scrollwork patterns that fill the vertical space above and below the text.

verificationChecks: Is the left panel textured like a book spine?
Does the lettering look hand-drawn rather than typeset?
Is the color palette sufficiently muted and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Primary color of the book spine (e.g., forest green instead of burgundy)
mustRedesign: Avoid using standard system fonts; must be custom or heavily modified.
Do not use modern photographic lighting; keep it soft and atmospheric.
Ensure the filigree does not look like generic clip-art; it should have a consistent stroke weight with the lettering.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the linen texture is visible across both the panel and the photo.
Ensure the text is legible despite its decorative nature.
Verify the vertical division is clean and sharp.
Confirm the subject's gaze leads toward the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Historical Graphic Element: Book Spine] with [Modern Moody Portrait] using [Texture: Linen/Canvas] and [Typography: Hand-drawn Whimsical Serif] to create a literary-inspired visual narrative.
